artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime and let $\mathbb{F}_p^*$ denote the multiplicative group of the finite field $\mathbb{F}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$. For a multiplicative subgroup $H \leq \mathbb{F}_p^*$ and $a \in \mathbb{F}_p^*$, consider the exponential sum
$$S(H,a) := \sum_{x \in H} e^{2\pi i a x / p}.$$
Determine the threshold on the size $|H|$ (as a function of $p$) which is necessary and sufficient to guarantee that
$$S(H,a) = o(|H|) \quad \text{as } p \to \infty,$$
uniformly in $a \in \mathbb{F}_p^*$. In particular, find the smallest function $f(p)$ such that whenever $|H| \geq f(p)$ the above bound holds for every $a \in \mathbb{F}_p^*$.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress exists but the optimal threshold is not known. Bourgain–Glibichuk–Konyagin established nontrivial cancellation for subgroups of size $|H| \geq p^\varepsilon$ for any fixed $\varepsilon>0$, and subsequent work (Shkredov, Shakan, Shteinikov, and others) has refined the bounds to subgroups of size somewhat smaller than $p^{1/4}$ with explicit savings. However, pushing down to subgroups of size $(\log p)^C$ — conjecturally the right threshold — remains open. Hence the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Exponential sums over small subgroups, revisited
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work improving cancellation bounds for exponential sums over small multiplicative subgroups of F_p.
status_evidence.claim: Active research has improved but not closed the question of the optimal size threshold.

status_evidence.title: Bourgain–Glibichuk: Exponential sum estimate over subgroups
status_evidence.snippet: Non-trivial bounds for exponential sums over multiplicative subgroups of size at least p^{epsilon}.
status_evidence.claim: Cancellation established for subgroups of size p^epsilon, falling short of the conjectured (log p)^C threshold.

status_evidence.title: New estimates for exponential sums over multiplicative subgroups and intervals in prime fields
status_evidence.snippet: Refined estimates for exponential sums over multiplicative subgroups of F_p.
status_evidence.claim: Bounds continue to be improved, indicating the optimal threshold remains unresolved.
